prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 4:5 editorial cover image, approximately 1080x1350
Primary request: A photorealistic Japanese-style kyotei motorboat racing scene on a wide lake course, with soft mountains on the horizon, an overcast sky, and gentle swell.
Scene/backdrop: Wide lake, subdued soft mountain silhouettes on the horizon, overcast weather. Keep the top 45 percent dark, visually quiet, and uncluttered for a later title overlay.
Subject: One authentic kyotei racing boat banking into a tight left turn around a plain orange-and-white cylindrical turn buoy, with spray curving outward. The boat is a single-seat racing craft about 3 meters long, flat, low, and long relative to the racer, with a white or pale-grey hull. It has an open cockpit: absolutely no canopy, roof, or windshield bubble. The racer crouches or kneels very low inside, leaning forward with both hands on a small steering wheel, wearing a completely plain full-face helmet and plain racing suit; face is not visible. One outboard motor is mounted on the stern, with a large white spray plume trailing behind.
Style/medium: Natural high-end sports photography, realistic Japanese boat-racing proportions and hydrodynamics, crisp subject with atmospheric background.
Composition/framing: Vertical 4:5. Boat and buoy entirely in the lower half; upper 45 percent is dark negative space. Dynamic turning angle while the boat remains clearly identifiable as kyotei, not offshore powerboat.
Lighting/mood: Moody soft overcast light, restrained contrast, dramatic but credible.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: No recognizable real person. Every helmet, suit, hull, motor, and buoy surface must be blank and unbranded.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, brands, watermarks, signatures, signage, number plates, emblems, flags, banners; no offshore powerboat, no F1 tunnel boat, no enclosed cockpit, no canopy, no roof, no windshield bubble; no additional boats or people.

verification.kyotei_boat: passed: one low, long single-seat racing boat with an open cockpit and one stern outboard motor
verification.turn_scene: passed: the boat banks through a tight left turn beside an orange-and-white cylindrical buoy, with spray curving outward
verification.composition: passed: portrait 4:5 with the boat in the lower half and a dark, uncluttered upper area
verification.prohibited_content: passed: no visible text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, or writing-like marks
verification.people: passed: the racer's face is obscured and no recognizable real person is depicted
